pages.title: Two pounds · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon at a busy neighborhood market in Chicago. Eva stands in front of a glass case full of meat. Chicken, beef and sausages are neatly arranged. Behind the counter, a butcher in a white apron sharpens a knife. His name tag says Dom. He greets her with a big smile.
“Good afternoon! What can I get you today?” says Dom. “I’d like two pounds of chicken, please.” says Eva. “Sure. Breasts or thighs?” says Dom.
